purpose: Classify listings by the real buyer question: who grabs this car quickly and why?

categories.FAST_BUY: Likely to attract ordinary buyers quickly. Open first.
categories.SAFE_BUY: Good/safe buyer-service car, but not urgent or not underpriced enough.
categories.FLIP_BUY: Possible margin for experienced reseller; needs inspection/negotiation.

psychological_price_zones.note: Corsa C: only cheap/TUV/simple petrol is interesting
Corsa D: core first-car demand, but retail price is not a flip
Corsa E: modern buyer demand, needs under-market price
Astra G: old, useful only cheap with TUV/rust proof
Astra H: practical cheap car, Kombi/1.6 petrol can work
Astra J: better buyer car than flip unless clearly cheap
Fiesta Mk5: cheap simple 1.25 petrol/TUV only
Fiesta Mk6: strong if 1.25 petrol, 5-door, TUV
Fiesta Mk7: good demand but usually above current young-flip budget
Focus Mk2: good if simple petrol/Turnier/TUV; rust and clutch matter
Focus Mk3: modern enough, but avoid PowerShift/EcoBoost without proof
Fabia I: practical but old; needs TUV and cheap entry
Fabia II: practical first-car demand, Combi can be useful
Fabia III: safe buyer car, only flip if underpriced
Yaris P1: reliable, but old/rust/TUV decide
Yaris XP90: very liquid, low-risk first car
Yaris XP130: very strong buyer demand, but often not cheap
Aygo I: safe small car; TUV and clutch/rust matter
Aygo II: easy resale but usually above flip budget
i10 PA: strong cheap first-car demand
i10 IA: low-risk modern city car
i20 PB: one of the best safe first-car patterns
i20 GB: very sellable, but needs real discount
Swift old: simple Japanese demand, body/rust important
Swift 2010+: strong quick-sale DNA if clean/TUV
Splash: safe small car, not exciting but can sell fast cheap
Jazz GD: high practicality/reliability, rust/TUV decide
Jazz GE: excellent safe first-car/family small car
Micra K12: cheap city car, only clean/TUV
Micra K13: decent low-risk city car if not CVT
Golf 4: cheap 1.6 petrol/manual around 1000-1300 EUR can be a strong manual CHECK even with short TUV, if no engine/gearbox/rust/document red flags.
Golf 5: liquid, but normal price is not opportunity
Golf 6: good only if engine/gearbox safe; TSI/DSG punished
Golf 7: modern demand but often above current youth-flip budget
Polo 9N: quick only cheap, TUV and clean body
Polo 6R: strong young-buyer demand when clean, 5-door/TUV/1.Hand
